entities.summary: Marc-Antoine Mathieu is a French comic book artist and writer. He is notably known by his experimental series Julius Corentin Acquefacques, prisonnier des rêves. He is also a set designer, through the Lucie Lom workshop, which he co-founded with Philippe Leduc.
